title: Madness Interactive Reloaded
tagline: Grunts, agents, a train and a very rich boss: fight your way through the whole campaign, one room at a time.
summary: Madness Interactive Reloaded (Studio Minus, 2024; version 0.51.1) is a fast side-on shooter in the style of the Madness Combat animations: you walk through rooms full of grunts and agents, shoot, dodge, punch, block with swords, pick up the weapons of the fallen and throw them, until enough bodies lie on the floor and the exit opens.

This port translates the game's C# logic line by line: the procedural animation of every character (body, head, hands, feet, recoil, iron sights), the enemies' aiming, panic, dodging and melee, the weapons with their damage, accuracy, recoil and ammunition, bullets that pass through bodies, bounce off blades and armour, the melee combos, the death animations and ragdolls, the levels with their doors, spawners and body counts, and the campaign's progress, kept in your account.

It plays the whole campaign "Employee of the Month" with its cutscenes, the train, the boss fights and the training program, plus the incident mode (a random run of incident levels with a kill target), the experiment mode (a sandbox where you place characters and weapons), the improbability disks hidden in the levels, the character customisation and the settings, all with the original data, graphics, sounds, videos and music.

controls.action: Shoot (or punch and strike when unarmed or holding a melee weapon)
Iron sights; block and deflect with a blade
Melee attack with the weapon in hand
Pick up the weapon nearest to the mouse
Abilities (when a character or disk gives you one)
Retry after dying; in the experiment: revive
Experiment mode: edit (place characters and weapons with a click)

caveat: Not ported: the level and campaign editors, the mod menu, the arena mode (switched off in the original too) and parts of the experiment mode's editing windows; the gore is simpler than the original's. The full game is large (about 630 MB): backgrounds, music and videos load while you play.
